environment.description: Same service deployed in namespace 'backend-services' on an Istio-enabled cluster. Istio sidecar injection is enabled for the namespace. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the mesh level (root namespace 'istio-system') with a DENY action matching source principals not in 'cluster.local/ns/backend-services/sa/*'. Additionally, a per-namespace AuthorizationPolicy in 'backend-services' uses ALLOW action requiring source.namespace == 'api-gateway' for paths matching '/api/*'. The MongoDB instance resides in namespace 'data-tier' which has its own AuthorizationPolicy requiring source.namespace == 'backend-services'. PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mTLS mesh-wide. Note: the gateway namespace 'api-gateway' runs an Envoy-based API gateway that performs request validation including query parameter schema enforcement (max 64 chars per parameter, alphanumeric plus hyphens only for username/role fields, no JSON object syntax allowed in query params).
